positions.name: AtlasRollbackDecisionRecord
positions.frame: What does the formal decision record commit the organization to regarding Atlas rollback rehearsals — cadence and ownership?
positions.why: src-1 issues the directive establishing the monthly cadence; src-3 restates that cadence as a labeled field in the structured decision record; src-4 assigns ownership in the same record. The conviction reads mark all three as 'decision' — settled, load-bearing, ratified rather than proposed — and the power reads mark all three 'legitimate' authority acts (directive issuance, cadence-setting, owner-naming) performed by the same position-holder in the same document. This is distinct from src-2, whose aphoristic maxim operates at the level of justificatory principle rather than performing the decision itself — its conviction reads as 'principle,' not 'decision,' so it is held apart rather than folded in.
